correctness.rationale: The ten coefficient-mask evaluations are injective by 1024 distinct 64-bit patterns. Every r-dimensional subspace of F_2^10 has a unique reduced-row-echelon basis; enumeration over all ordered increasing pivot tuples and every allowable nonpivot right-of-pivot entry therefore visits all Gaussian-binomial [10 choose r]_2 subspaces exactly once. The subcode support is the bitwise OR of evaluations of its basis; population-count minimum and number attaining it are exact. Independently compiled a new Gray-code-driven C++ enumerator (distinct from inspected artifacts/verify.cpp) for ALL r=1..10, including 53,743,987 4-spaces and 109,221,651 5-spaces; reproduced all 10 weights and minimizer counts (112,448,64,28,1120,24,1456,2016,64,1). Thus this exhaustive finite certificate legitimately proves all claimed minima; no extrapolation to other codes.
